risks: Deploy workflows reference third-party Actions by SHA at PR-open time. If `amondnet/vercel-action`, `cloudflare/pages-action`, or `supabase/setup-cli` upstream gets force-pushed, the next phase-2 PR must re-resolve the SHA.

The cloudflare-waf job's `jq` wrap into the v4 ruleset envelope assumes `cloudflare-rules.json` stays a top-level JSON array. If the SSOT shape changes (e.g. to a `{ rules: [...] }` object directly), the wrap function must change too.

`gh secret set --repo OWNER/REPO` requires the operator to be authenticated to GitHub and to OWNER/REPO. The --deploy hint prints the literal `OWNER/REPO` token; operators must substitute the real repo before pasting.
